ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is divided into four climate-type sections according to Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding, and each section uses column symbols to show annual precipitation and monthly mean temperature conditions. Jia is located on the far left. Jia’s annual precipitation column is relatively high, about around 1500 millimeters; the temperature range corresponding to monthly mean temperature is generally warm, roughly between the teens and more than twenty degrees Celsius, with little annual temperature range. Reasoning: Jia shows warm conditions throughout the year, relatively abundant precipitation, and dry-wet season characteristics, which conforms to the characteristics of a tropical savanna climate. Among the commonly corresponding cities, Brasília has a tropical savanna climate, so the city corresponding to Jia is Brasília.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure shows the monthly mean temperature and annual precipitation conditions of four climate types.

<image1>

According to the information in the figure, which city corresponds to climate type Jia?

method.method_draft: Read the prompt as asking only for the city corresponding to climate type 甲. From the 甲 graph, note annual precipitation is relatively high, around 1500 mm, and monthly mean temperatures remain warm all year with only a modest range. Classify this as a tropical/savanna-type climate. Among the relevant cities, Brasília is the city with that climate, so answer 巴西利亚.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中按甲、乙、丙、丁分成四个气候类型小区，每个小区用柱状符号表示年降水量和月均温状况。甲位于最左侧，甲的年降水量柱较高，约在1500毫米左右；月均温对应的温度范围整体偏暖，大致在十几到二十多摄氏度之间，全年温差不大。推理：甲表现为全年温暖、降水较多且有干湿季特征，符合热带草原气候特征。在常见对应城市中，巴西利亚属于热带草原气候，因此甲对应的城市是巴西利亚。

method.method_draft: Use the prompt to list the four labels 甲、乙、丙、丁 as climate types to match with cities. First match the easiest panels: 丁’s cold-to-hot annual temperature span matches Beijing; 乙’s mild oceanic values match London; 丙’s warm-temperate pattern matches Cape Town. The remaining graph, 甲, shows warm year-round temperatures and high rainfall, so by elimination it corresponds to Brasília. Answer 巴西利亚.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中分为甲、乙、丙、丁四个气候类型小图，左侧纵轴为年降水量（mm），右侧纵轴为月均温（℃）；图例显示斜线柱表示年降水量，空白柱表示月均温范围。甲的年降水量较高，约在1500mm左右，月均温全年偏暖；乙的气温年较差较小、较温和，降水中等；丙表现为暖温带特征；丁的月均温从较低到较高变化幅度大，气温年较差明显。
推理：按指定方法先匹配最容易判断的类型：丁的冬冷夏热、气温年较差大，符合北京；乙温和湿润、海洋性明显，符合伦敦；丙为暖温带型，符合南半球的开普敦。剩下的甲全年较暖且降水量较高，因此对应巴西利亚。
